g.title: First Contribution: Made your first contribution to GitHub.
7 Day Streak: Maintained a contribution streak for 7 consecutive days.
30 Day Streak: Maintained a contribution streak for 30 consecutive days.
100 Contributions: Reached 100 total contributions in a year.
100 Active Days: Active on GitHub for at least 100 distinct days.
Night Coder: Pushed 15+ contributions in a single day.
Galaxy Explorer: Mapped your contribution history into the galaxy.
